_doc: M1 R2 stub manifest. cf-audio::AudioCue::stub_tag() maps cue → tag; real backends look up tag → wav path here. Until M4+, every wav field is null because no SFX has been authored. cf-audio::NullAudioPlugin honours every cue with a tracing trace; cf-audio::RecordingAudioPlugin captures cues for tests. The manifest is checked into git so cf-content-loader can validate the cue/tag space against schema drift.
